text: On an annual basis, the Auditor General reviews the implementation status of outstanding audit recommendations and reports the review results to the City Council through the Audit Committee. This report provides the recommendation follow-up results for the following two Toronto Parking Authority (TPA) reports: - Toronto Parking Authority – Phase 1: Audit of Real Estate Activities, 2015 - Toronto Parking Authority Phase 2: Audit of the Revenue Operations of Off-Street Controlled Facilities, 2016. Under the current interim Toronto Parking Authority Board governance structure and operations, Toronto Parking Authority real estate activity has been substantially curtailed. All transactions in-process and going forward are expected to be conducted pursuant to the new City-wide real estate model and amended authorities adopted by City Council.
